question: Describe the post history counts and last edit date of the post title "What is the best introductory Bayesian statistics textbook?"

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS PostHistoryCount, MAX(T2.CreationDate) AS LastEditDate
FROM posts AS T1
JOIN postHistory AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.PostId
WHERE T1.Title = 'What is the best introductory Bayesian statistics textbook?'
